rename.to: ES 6.0 regression: "query must be rewritten first" exception when using terms lookup filter in nested aggregation

body: Thanks @mrszg it's a bug in the rewrite phase of aggregations, only the root aggregation gets rewritten and sub aggregations are skipped. I'll take a look.
It seems that version 6.1.0 is affected too.
@jimczi Do you know when this bug will be fixed?

Unfortunately this bug requires a larger fix than I initially thought. The rewriting of aggregations has a bug when multiple rewrite of the query is needed, the `terms` query is rewritten in multiple rounds (create the fetch query to get the document, retrieve the document and creates the final query) but currently only one rewrite is called. We know how to fix this but it will require some time, I cannot give any date or version for the fix though @lbrzekowski , I'll update this issue when I have a pr ready for it.
@jimczi Can you provide any update on this issue?

issue.title: Adds metadata to rewritten aggregations

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Previous to this change, if any filters in the filters aggregation were rewritten, the rewritten version of the FiltersAggregationBuilder would not contain the metadata form the original. This is because `AbstractAggregationBuilder.getMetadata()` returns an empty map when not metadata is set.

Closes #28170

issue.title: Add a shallow copy method to aggregation builders

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
This change adds a shallow copy method for aggregation builders. This method returns a copy of the builder replacing the factoriesBuilder and metaData.
This method is used when the builder is rewritten (AggregationBuilder#rewrite) in order to make sure that we create a new instance of the parent builder when sub aggregations are rewritten.

Relates #27782

Relates #28430
